Nigeria international Calvin Bassey is expected to feature prominently on Mauricio Pochettino’s list of potential Manchester United targets ahead of the January transfer window. According to The Telegraph, the Fulham defender is among the options being considered as the new United head coach prepares to strengthen his side’s defence. Pochettino, who is expected to begin work at Old Trafford later this week, faces the task of improving a backline that has struggled this season. United have conceded 19 goals in their opening 10 Premier League matches, with their defensive problems making reinforcements a priority ahead of the winter transfer window. Bassey’s pace, physical presence and versatility are understood to make him an attractive option. The 26-year-old can operate at centre-back and left-back, potentially offering cover in both positions. EPL: Pochettino’s Man Utd targets Super Eagles defender Bassey – Report Why more English footballers are moving abroad – Report EPL: Rice confirms new Arsenal contract is close The Nigerian has also impressed since joining Fulham from Ajax in 2023 and has captained the club under head coach Alvaro Arbeloa this season. Arbeloa has praised the defender’s performances and expressed his desire to secure him on a new contract. However, Bassey’s current deal runs until next summer, although Fulham have an option to extend it by another 12 months. The situation could leave the London club facing a decision if United make a substantial offer in January. Bassey previously played for Rangers and Ajax before returning to the Premier League with Fulham, where he has established himself as a regular. Kindly share this story:
